Why A9 is the substantive new object: Warrant is not Det, not EU, and not Authorization: Det: evaluation -> a discrete epistemic stance; EU: a utility model over a feasible action set; Warrant: contract-relative adequacy of an ACTION against 7 declared requirement families; Authorize: a governance act by an authority. It occupies a slot the pipeline had left implicit -- between deciding what to do and being permitted to do it, there is being justified in doing it. And the source explicitly refuses the cheap definition, W_t = EU(a) > 0, 'that would make warrant entirely dependent on one utility model.' T3, not T4. Warrant is an evaluation over K, like Det. It adds no primitive, states no canonical relation, and constrains no component of K.
